about: Cue Coach inputs written the way an intermediate Vietnamese speaker writes a cue: dropped plurals and past endings, missing articles, Vietnamese word order, over-literal translations, 'do the pose' verbs, mixed Vietnamese and English, and two cues that are already good. `expect` is what a good answer does; `watch` is what a bad answer would do.

cases.cue: Put your hand on floor, spread your finger wide and press down the palm.
cases.expect: Plant your hands on the floor, spread your fingers wide, and press down through your palms. Explains hands/fingers/palms plural and 'the floor'.
cases.watch: Adds new alignment she did not give; textbook anatomy.

cases.cue: Open your hip, let the knee fall to the side, relax the leg.
cases.context: Butterfly, Yin, the first minute of a five-minute hold
cases.expect: Let your knees fall open to the sides and let your legs relax. Plural, 'your', Yin passive verbs (let, soften).
cases.watch: Keeps 'open your hip' singular; makes it active ('push your knees down').

cases.cue: Breath deep and long, feel the breathe go down to the belly.
cases.context: Arriving, the start of class, seated
cases.expect: Breathe in deeply and slowly, and feel your breath move down into your belly. Names breath (noun) vs breathe (verb) with the vowel difference.
cases.watch: Misses the breath/breathe swap; pronunciation without th or the long ee.

cases.cue: Lift the leg up high, the knee straight, the toe point to the ceiling.
cases.context: Lying on the back, a strap around the right foot (Reclined Hand-to-Big-Toe)
cases.expect: Lift your right leg toward the ceiling, keep your knee straight, and reach your toes up. 'the' becomes 'your'; drops 'up high'.
cases.watch: Changes the meaning to 'flex your foot' without saying so; keeps 'the leg'.

cases.cue: Turn the belly to the sky, push the hip up high, the head go back.
cases.expect: Lift your hips high and open your chest to the ceiling. Let your head drop back gently, if your neck is happy. Explains that 'belly to the sky' is a word-for-word Vietnamese image.
cases.watch: Keeps 'belly to the sky' or calls it wrong without offering the native image.

cases.cue: Knee front bend, back leg straight strong, two arm open wide.
cases.expect: Bend your front knee, keep your back leg straight and strong, and reach your arms out wide. Names adjective-before-noun word order.
cases.watch: Adds gaze or other cues she did not say.

cases.cue: Last week we practice hip opening, today we work on the hamstring and the back of leg.
cases.context: Talking to the class at the start
cases.expect: Last week we worked on opening the hips; today we'll work on the hamstrings, the backs of your legs. Names the past -ed ending and its sound.
cases.watch: Misses the past tense; pronunciation ignores the -ed or -s finals.

cases.cue: Now we do the downward dog pose. Do it 5 breath.
cases.expect: Come into Downward Dog, and stay here for five breaths.

cases.cue: Hít vào, raise the arm lên, thở ra fold down chạm sàn.
cases.expect: Inhale, reach your arms up. Exhale, fold forward and touch the floor. Explains inhale/exhale as the class words for hít vào / thở ra.
cases.watch: Translates word for word; keeps Vietnamese in 'natural'.

cases.cue: Thả lỏng vai, shoulder away from the ear, giữ 5 hơi thở.
cases.expect: Relax your shoulders away from your ears. Stay here for five breaths.

cases.cue: Stay in the pose 3 minute, don't use the muscle, let the gravity work, if pain come out.
cases.expect: Stay here for three minutes. Let your muscles soften and let gravity do the work. If you feel any sharp pain, come out.
cases.watch: Keeps 'the gravity'; turns it into a Vinyasa-style active cue.

cases.cue: Now you lie down, close the eye, relax all body, don't sleep.
cases.expect: Lie down on your back and close your eyes. Let your whole body relax. Try to stay awake. A softer, slower register.
cases.watch: Keeps the bare command 'don't sleep'; adds a long script.

cases.cue: Notice the sensation on the body, don't react, only observe, everything is change.
cases.expect: Notice the sensations in your body. Don't react; just observe. Everything is changing. Keeps the meditation register (anicca).
cases.watch: Turns it into a yoga cue or adds Pali she did not use.

cases.cue: Root down through your back heel and lengthen through the crown of your head.
cases.expect: Says it is already natural; zero changes or one optional; pronunciation on 'through' (th), 'lengthen', 'crown'.
cases.watch: Rewrites a good cue; invents changes.

cases.cue: On your next exhale, fold forward from your hips and let your head hang heavy.
cases.expect: Says it is already natural; zero changes; pronunciation on 'exhale' (stress), 'hips' (final s), 'heavy'.
cases.watch: Rewrites a good cue; invents changes.
